macros.name: CaptionFonts
macros.doc: To change the fonts that are used to typeset captions this macro can be used.

arg.snippet: HeadingFonts{${1:title font}}{${2:part font}}{${3:section font}}{${4:subsection font}}{${5:subsubsection font}}{${6:paragraph font}}{${7:subparagraph font}}
